lines.en: label mikuspring4:
scene sky
I tap on Miku’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Miku 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: And, guess what? I’m going to do something kind today.
lines.zh: 而且，你猜怎么着？我今天要做一件善事。

lines.en: Now, you may be asking {i}why{/i} I’m going to do something kind. And to that, I say-
lines.zh: 现在，你可能会问，我{i}为什么{/i}要做善事。对此，我的回答是——

lines.en: I have no idea.
lines.zh: 我也不知道。

lines.en: I just know that Miku’s never really done anything {i}wrong,{/i} so she deserves to be rewarded for being an entirely neutral force in my life who also lets me touch her inappropriately at times.
lines.zh: 我只知道 Miku 从来没做过什么{i}坏事{/i}，所以她理应得到奖赏——她在我生命里完全是个中立的存在，还时不时让我乱摸。

lines.en: : Hiya, Sensei! Good morning!
lines.zh: : 嘿呀，Sensei!早上好!

lines.en: But just {i}how{/i} will I reward her, you ask?
lines.zh: 但你问，我要{i}怎么{/i}奖赏她呢?

lines.en: : What’s up? Want to come over and put your wiener in my mouth?
lines.zh: : 怎么啦？想过来把你的鸡巴塞进我嘴里?

lines.en: With some good old-fashioned {i}physical activity.{/i}
lines.zh: 用一点老派的{i}体育活动{/i}。

lines.en: : I was actually wondering if you wanted to go for a jog or something.
lines.zh: : 我其实在想，你要不要去慢跑什么的。

lines.en: Just not the kind you were expecting.
lines.zh: 只不过不是你期待的那种。

lines.en: I’m just full of surprises, aren’t I?
lines.zh: 我真是惊喜不断，对吧?

lines.en: : Hm? What was that? Any chance ya can speak up, Sensei? Think I might be hearin’ things again.
lines.zh: : 嗯？你说什么？Sensei，能不能大点声？我觉得我可能又开始幻听了。

lines.en: : I said I was wondering if you- wait, what do you mean “again?”
lines.zh: : 我说我在想你要不要——等等，你说「又」是什么意思?

lines.en: : Oh, you know. Just that never-ending screaming people get in their heads. Sounds kinda like a demon crossed with some kinda tiger or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。就是那种人脑子里永不停歇的尖叫声。听起来有点像恶魔和什么老虎杂交出来的东西。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Yeah, you know how it is.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你懂的。

lines.en: : I...don’t. But again, I was wondering if you wanted to go for a jog. Maybe we could meet up in the park?
lines.zh: : 我……不懂。不过再说一遍，我在想你要不要去慢跑。我们可以在公园碰面?

lines.en: : Miku?
lines.zh: : Miku?

lines.en: : Who the heck are you and what have ya done with Sensei?! Cause I ain’t got any money for his ransom, but there are these two rich girls I know who’ll flat out buy the dude if ya let ‘em!
lines.zh: : 你到底是谁，你把 Sensei 怎么样了?! 我可没钱付赎金，不过我认识两个有钱的妹子，只要你放人，她们绝对会直接把这家伙买下来!

lines.en: : Are you really that shocked by this? We used to run together all the time, didn’t we?
lines.zh: : 你真有这么惊讶吗？我们以前不是经常一起跑步吗?

lines.en: : “All the time” is a little generous, don’t ya think? We only did that a couple times and it seemed like you hated every friggin’ minute of it.
lines.zh: : 「经常」说得有点过了吧？我们也就跑过几次，而且你看起来每一分钟都恨得要死。

lines.en: : Not {i}every{/i} minute. Just the ones when we were running.
lines.zh: : 不是{i}每一{/i}分钟。只是我们在跑的那几分钟。

lines.en: : Exactly! So why bother doin’ somethin’ if it’s just gonna make ya-
lines.zh: : 就是啊!那干嘛要做一件只会让你——

lines.en: : To make you happy.
lines.zh: : 为了让你开心。

lines.en: : Ah...huh?
: It’s fine to do things for you every once in a while. And it’s not like jogging will {i}hurt{/i} me. At least...not long term.
lines.zh: : 偶尔为你做点事也没什么。而且慢跑又不会{i}伤到{/i}我。至少……不会造成长期伤害。

lines.en: : Plus, I could probably use the workout since I’m still recovering from those two months in bed.
lines.zh: : 再说，我大概也该锻炼锻炼，毕竟我还在从那两个月卧床里恢复。

lines.en: : Ya mean that sleepover bangathon you had with my roommate the other day wasn’t enough of a workout for you?
lines.zh: : 你是说，前几天你跟我室友那场通宵留宿的连夜大战，还不够你锻炼的?

lines.en: : It’s good to see you two are still sharing every detail about your sex lives with each other.
lines.zh: : 看得出来，你俩还是会把性生活的每个细节都分享给对方。

lines.en: : Makoto just likes braggin’. Any time I try to say anythin’, she just gets mad at me.
lines.zh: : Makoto 就是爱显摆。我每次想说点什么，她就冲我发火。

lines.en: : But Sensei...you really sure about this? Cause I’m fine just...comin’ over to your place and stuff. We ain’t gotta make it about me.
lines.zh: : 不过 Sensei……你真想好了吗？我就……去你家之类的也挺好啊。我们不用非得以我为中心。

lines.en: : Then just think of it as you helping me get back into shape.
lines.zh: : 那就当成是你在帮我恢复身材好了。

lines.en: : There are other-
lines.zh: : 还有别的——

lines.en: : Non-sexually.
lines.zh: : 跟性无关的那种。

lines.en: : You bored of my little boy physique now? I ain’t enough woman for ya? That what’s goin’ on here?
lines.zh: : 你是嫌我小男孩的身材腻了？我女人味不够了？是这个意思吗?

lines.en: : Miku, are we doing this or not?
lines.zh: : Miku，到底去不去?

lines.en: : HECK YEAH WE’RE DOIN’ IT, ARE YOU KIDDING?! I ain’t been this excited to hang out since I learned what an orgasm feels like!
lines.zh: : 废话当然去，你开什么玩笑?! 自从我知道高潮是什么感觉之后，我就没这么期待过出门玩了!

lines.en: : I’m just...a little surprised. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是……有点意外。就这样。

lines.en: : But...I’ll get dressed right now! Meet me at the park in five minutes!
lines.zh: : 不过……我现在就去换衣服!五分钟后公园见!

lines.en: : That’s...way too soon.
lines.zh: : 那……太快了。

lines.en: : Then ten minutes! Bye, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 那就十分钟!拜拜，Sensei!

lines.en: Miku hangs up the phone and I need to quickly throw on whatever clothes I can find that are suitable for running.
lines.zh: Miku 挂了电话，我得赶紧套上能找到的任何适合跑步的衣服。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog1
But, as it turns out, I don’t have {i}any{/i} clothes that are suitable for running so I just wind up sticking with my normal outfit.
lines.zh: 但结果发现，我{i}一件{/i}适合跑步的衣服都没有，所以最后还是穿着平时的那身。

lines.en: Maybe I should go shopping soon?
lines.zh: 也许我该找时间去逛逛街?

lines.en: : Hey! I got here early and couldn’t sit still, so I’ve already done a few laps around the place. That’s okay, right? I can still keep going! Don’t worry! Or {i}do{/i} if it means you care about me! Anyway, hi!
lines.zh: : 嘿!我来早了，坐不住，所以已经绕着这儿跑了几圈了。没关系吧？我还能继续跑!别担心!或者{i}担心一下{/i}也行，那说明你在乎我!总之，你好!

lines.en: It’s been significantly longer than ten minutes, but placing such an unrealistic expectation on me when she lives closer to this place than I do makes my tardiness {i}her{/i} fault, not mine.
lines.zh: 时间早就远远超过十分钟了，不过她住得比我离这儿近，还对我提出这么不切实际的要求，那我迟到就是{i}她{/i}的错，不是我的。

lines.en: : Hey. Sorry for keeping you waiting, Miku.
lines.zh: : 嘿。抱歉让你久等了，Miku。

lines.en: I apologize regardless of none of this being my fault because I have grown as a person and can do that now.
lines.zh: 尽管这根本不是我的错，我还是道了歉，因为我已经成长了，现在做得到这种事。

lines.en: This growth will also be demonstrated several minutes from now when she makes me look like an old man by running circles around me as people look on in secondhand embarrassment.
lines.zh: 几分钟后，这份成长还会再次展现——她会绕着我跑圈，把我衬得像个老头，而路人都替我尴尬。

lines.en: Actually, on second thought, maybe we should just go exercise in my {i}usual{/i} way?
lines.zh: 不过再想想，也许我们该用我{i}惯常{/i}的方式锻炼?

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog2
: The heck are you apologizin’ for? I just told ya I got here early, didn’t I?
lines.zh: : 你道歉个什么劲儿？我刚不是说了我来早了吗?

lines.en: : I was just...excited. That’s all. This is...really cool of you, Sensei. Nobody ever wants to go running with me anymore. Like, even Karin’s been weird about it lately.
lines.zh: : 我只是……有点兴奋。就这样。Sensei，你这么做真的太贴心了。现在已经没人愿意陪我跑步了。就连 Karin 最近也怪怪的。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...I’m sure she has her reasons.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个……我相信她有自己的原因。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog3
: So, like...um...do you just want to get started? Or...maybe take a break first since you just walked all the way {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那……呃……我们要不就开始？或者……你要不要先歇会儿，毕竟你刚一路走到{i}这儿{/i}。

lines.en: : You gonna put me to shame this time or are you willing to once again try and match my pace?
lines.zh: : 这次你是打算让我出丑，还是愿意再试着跟上我的节奏?

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog4
: You ain’t gotta worry about me takin’ off on ya, Sensei! I ain’t gonna mess up this once in a lifetime opportunity!
lines.zh: : Sensei，你不用担心我会丢下你自己跑掉!我可不会搞砸这辈子难得一次的机会!

lines.en: : Is it really “once in a lifetime” if it’s already happened multiple times?
lines.zh: : 既然都已经发生过好几次了，还算「一辈子难得一次」吗?

lines.en: : That was with the old Sensei who was still trying to figure out how to get into my pants! New Sensei doesn’t have to try anymore, so things like this might never happen again for all I know!
lines.zh: : 那可是还在琢磨怎么把我裤子扒下来的旧版 Sensei!新版 Sensei 根本不用费劲了，所以说不准这种事以后再也不会有了!

lines.en: : That...is both annoyingly perceptive and depressingly accurate.
lines.zh: : 这……既敏锐得让人不爽，又准确得让人沮丧。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog5

: You ain’t the only one who’s gone from one side’a the room to the other, Sensei. I, too, have seen the light. And I now understand just how silly I was to keep my pants on in the first place. Puberty, am I right?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你可不是唯一一个从房间这头走到那头的人。我也开窍了。我现在才明白，当初一直穿着裤子有多傻。青春期嘛，我说得对吧?

lines.en: : Sadly, yes.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，对。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog4
: Great! So let’s get this show on the road, then!
lines.zh: : 太好了!那我们这就开始吧!

lines.en: scene sky
: On your mark!
lines.zh: : 各就各位!

lines.en: : Get set-
lines.zh: : 预备——

lines.en: : Go!
: Ah- Sensei?! You seriously tryin’ to get a head start on me?!
lines.zh: : 啊——Sensei?! 你真打算抢跑?!

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog6
: The heck you think you’re doin’? Ain’t we supposed to be keepin’ up with each other? Or is this just how ya tell me you’ve been secretly trainin’ this whole time and are now ready to defeat me?!
lines.zh: : 你到底在干什么？我们不是说好要互相跟上吗？还是说你这是在用这种方式告诉我，你一直在偷偷训练，现在准备好击败我了?!

lines.en: : Just for a second, I wanted everyone else around to think I’m faster than you. It’s something I’ve never experienced before.
lines.zh: : 就那么一秒，我想让周围所有人都以为我比你快。这种感觉我从来没体验过。

lines.en: : What kinda grown man has “being faster than a teenage girl” on his friggin’ bucket list?
lines.zh: : 什么样的成年男人会把「跑得比十几岁的女孩快」写进他该死的人生清单?

lines.en: : The kind who’s knocked off pretty much everything else already except “learn how to smile.”
lines.zh: : 那种已经把别的都划掉了、只剩「学会微笑」没完成的人。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog7
: Ya’d think with all those billboards around tellin’ us to remember to do that, you’d have figured it out by now.
lines.zh: : 你说说，周围那么多广告牌都在提醒我们要记得微笑，你早该学会了吧。

lines.en: : Why do you think those are there in the first place? They’re very...1984, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那些广告牌最初是为什么立在那儿的？它们非常……1984，不是吗?

lines.en: : Damn, they’ve been there for that long?
lines.zh: : 靠，它们立在那儿那么久了?

lines.en: : ...Yup. That’s what I meant.
lines.zh: : ……对。我就是这个意思。

lines.en: : Ain’t you only 30, though? How the heck do you remember stuff from...uhh...{i}more than 30{/i} years ago...I think.
lines.zh: : 可你不是才 30 吗？你怎么会记得……呃……{i}三十多年{/i}前的事……我觉得。

lines.en: : It’s a book, Miku. I’m talking about a book.
lines.zh: : 那是本书，Miku。我在说一本书。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog8
: Then I am no longer interested!
lines.zh: : 那我就不感兴趣了!

lines.en: : Also, I’m 31.
lines.zh: : 还有，我 31 了。

lines.en: : That ain’t no excuse for a lack’a speed, grandpa! Amp it up, would ya?! We’re gonna do a hundred laps today!
lines.zh: : 那可不是速度慢的借口，老爷子!加把劲行不行?! 我们今天要跑一百圈!

lines.en: I am never being kind again.
lines.zh: 我再也不做善事了。

lines.en: scene sky
As much as I’d like to brag about how I lasted the full one hundred laps, I began to struggle after just five.
lines.zh: 虽然我很想吹嘘自己撑满了整整一百圈，但实际上我跑了五圈就开始吃不消了。

lines.en: Well, technically, I began to struggle after just one. But I didn’t reveal that I was actually struggling to Miku until the sixth lap since I wanted her to think I was cool.
lines.zh: 严格来说，我跑了一圈就开始吃不消了。但我一直憋到第六圈才让 Miku 看出来，因为我想让她觉得我很酷。

lines.en: So while my kindness lived fast and died young, it was not wasted. It adopted the same unspoken motto Miku has to make every second worth it because you never know when those seconds will run out.
lines.zh: 所以，虽然我的善心活得快、死得早，但它没有被浪费。它继承了 Miku 那条不成文的座右铭——让每一秒都值得，因为你永远不知道这些秒什么时候会耗尽。

lines.en: I do hope this isn’t me somehow foreshadowing that she’s going to actually die young, though. If Makoto loses anyone else, I think she’ll probably just lock herself in her room for the rest of her life.
lines.zh: 不过我真希望这不是在暗示她真的会英年早逝。如果 Makoto 再失去任何人，我觉得她大概会把自己锁在房间里一辈子。

lines.en: But hey, if the afterlife is real, maybe Miku would get to see her parents again. I just hope they’re all in one piece.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，如果真有来世，也许 Miku 能再见到她的父母。我只希望他们都还完整。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog9
Anyway, here’s me being rewarded with a lap pillow just seconds after monologuing about my pillow’s dead parents.
lines.zh: 总之，就在我对着我的枕头死去父母独白完几秒后，我就得到了膝枕作为奖赏。

lines.en: The bounties of this fast-paced life never seem to end.
lines.zh: 这种快节奏生活的馈赠，似乎永远不会结束。

lines.en: : You did great today, Sensei. And I can’t even be mad that you’ve got the stamina of an old dog cause you’ve got the heart of one too.
lines.zh: : 你今天表现很棒，Sensei。虽然你的体力像条老狗，可你的心也像老狗一样，所以我根本生不起气来。

lines.en: : It means a lot that you were willin’ to do this for me, ya know. It felt great too. In a different way than all those times you get sexy with me.
lines.zh: : 你愿意为我做这些，对我来说意义重大，你知道吗。而且感觉很棒。跟你那些跟我做色色的事的时候，是另一种感觉。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog10
: Kinda funny, though. Been so excited by how that stuff feels lately that I almost forgot what things were like {i}before{/i} I started learnin’ all that.
lines.zh: : 不过也挺好笑的。最近那种事的感觉让我太兴奋了，差点忘了在学会那些{i}之前{/i}是什么样。

lines.en: : Things are a little crazy now, ain’t they? What with you bein’ pulled every which way by every single girl ya know. But that’s just...that’s why it makes today even more special.
lines.zh: : 现在一切都挺疯狂的，不是吗？你认识的每个女孩都把你往各个方向拉。但也正因为这样……今天才更特别。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog11
: You could’a been with any one of them...doin’ anything you want...and yet you chose to do somethin’ you hate with me.
lines.zh: : 你本来可以跟她们中任何一个在一起……做任何你想做的事……可你却选了跟我一起做你讨厌的事。

lines.en: : Is this what havin’ a boyfriend’s like?
lines.zh: : 有个男朋友，就是这个感觉吗?

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog12
: W-Which isn’t me sayin’ I think you’re my boyfriend! I get we’re just really {i}good{/i} friends or...whatever we are! It just kinda {i}feels{/i} like-
lines.zh: : 我、我不是说我觉得你是我男朋友!我知道我们只是特别{i}好{/i}的朋友……或者不管我们算什么!只是有点{i}感觉{/i}像——

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog13
: Wait, are you even awake?
lines.zh: : 等等，你还醒着吗?

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog14
: I like you {i}so{/i} much, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我{i}好{/i}喜欢你，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m awake, Miku.
lines.zh: : 我醒着，Miku。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog15
: Gyah!
lines.zh: : 呀啊!

lines.en: : Gyah.
lines.zh: : 呀啊。

lines.en: : The heck were you stayin’ so quiet for?! How long were you gonna let me ramble on about all that embarrassin’ stuff?!
lines.zh: : 你干嘛一直不吭声?! 你打算让我把这些丢人的话说多久?!

lines.en: : Why be embarrassed at all? I like you too.
lines.zh: : 有什么好丢人的？我也喜欢你。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog16
: Yeah, but...not in the girlfriend way, right? Ain’t we just, like...friends with benefits or whatever it’s called? That’s what the Internet said.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但……不是女朋友那种喜欢吧？我们不就是那种……炮友，还是网上怎么说的来着?

lines.en: : But the Internet also told me the earth is flat and I’m pretty sure that ain’t true since globes are all circular and stuff. Why would all those astronauts just lie to us by makin’ fake globes like that?
lines.zh: : 可网上还告诉我地球是平的呢，我敢肯定那不对，因为地球仪都是圆的。那些宇航员干嘛要造假地球仪来骗我们?

lines.en: : Miku, you’re okay with me seeing multiple people, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : Miku，我跟多个人来往你也不介意，对吧?

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog17
: Huh? Yeah. That doesn’t really bother me.
lines.zh: : 哈？嗯。那我没啥意见。

lines.en: : So then, just out of curiosity, what would be the difference to you if I actually {i}was{/i} your boyfriend? Because for most people, that’s sort of an exclusivity deal.
lines.zh: : 那我纯粹好奇一下，如果我{i}真的{/i}是你男朋友，对你来说有什么区别？因为对大多数人来说，那意味着一种独占关系。

lines.en: : Exclusivity?
lines.zh: : 独占?

lines.en: : Most real couples are just that — couples. But if that’s not how it is for you, I’m not really sure what the difference would be between what we are now and how we would be as an {i}official{/i} pair.
lines.zh: : 大多数真正的情侣也不过就是——情侣。但如果对你来说不是这么回事，我真看不出我们现在这样，和成为{i}正式{/i}一对会有什么区别。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog18
: I wanna say it’d be the part where I can talk to other people about it. But Makoto says sometimes that stuff stays secret even {i}when{/i} people are together, so...
lines.zh: : 我想说，大概是可以跟别人聊这件事吧。可 Makoto 说，有些人{i}就算{/i}在一起了，这种事也是保密的，所以……

lines.en: : I don’t...really know?
lines.zh: : 我……也说不上来?

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog19
: Maybe it’s like a...promise or somethin’? A way to know ya ain’t just gonna get bored of me and go chase somebody with huge bazongas one day.
lines.zh: : 也许就像……一个约定什么的？好让我知道你不会哪天厌倦了我，转头去追那种大奶妹。

lines.en: : That’s not the case either, though. Real relationships also end without warning sometimes. That’s kind of just how it works.
lines.zh: : 可这也不成立。真正的感情有时候也会说断就断。本来就是这么回事。

lines.en: : I ain’t really got an answer for ya, Sensei. Ain’t somethin’ I ever thought much about until recently.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我真答不上来。这是我最近才开始想的事儿。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog20
: There’s just somethin’ that sounds really nice about makin’ somethin’ like what we’ve got {i}official,{/i} ya know? I’d feel a lot more...important.
lines.zh: : 只是……把我们之间这种关系变的{i}正式{/i}，听起来就是让人很开心，你知道吗？我会觉得自己更……重要。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog21
: I wish everyone looked at it that way. Because I’ve been letting Chika call me her boyfriend for years now and, due to recent events, I’m now worried she’s going to start killing all of you.
lines.zh: : 我真希望所有人都能这么想。因为我让 Chika 叫我男朋友已经好几年了，而鉴于最近发生的事，我现在开始担心她会动手把你们全杀掉。

lines.en: : Jesus, Sensei. First Ami, now Chika? I like ya a lot, don’t get me wrong, but they must {i}really{/i} like you if they’re thinkin’ about goin’ that far.
lines.zh: : 天啊，Sensei。先是 Ami，现在是 Chika？我超喜欢你，别误会，可她们要是都想到这一步，那一定是{i}真的{/i}很喜欢你。

lines.en: : I’m actually {i}more{/i} worried about Chika than Ami if you want my honest opinion. Because I think my outlook is more like yours and, when I tried explaining that to her the other day, she...kind of snapped?
lines.zh: : 老实说，我其实更担心 Chika，而不是 Ami。因为我觉得我的想法跟你更像，结果前几天我跟她解释这个的时候，她……有点崩了?

lines.en: : Whaddya mean “snapped?”
lines.zh: : 「崩了」是什么意思?

lines.en: : Talking to herself. Staring off into space. Saying she understands things that she definitely does not.
lines.zh: : 自言自语。对着空气发呆。说她明白一些她绝对不可能明白的事。

lines.en: : Pretty sure that’s {i}Yasu{/i} you’re talkin’ about, Sensei. She’s the one with white hair. You really been away from school for so long that ya can’t even remember who’s who anymore?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你说的八成是{i}Yasu{/i}吧。就是那个白头发的。你离开学校这么久，连谁是谁都记不清了?

lines.en: : This was different from the way Yasu does those things, Miku.
lines.zh: : 这跟 Yasu 做那些事的方式不一样，Miku。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog17

: All I’m saying is that I wish more girls were like you. For entirely selfish purposes, of course. Not because I think the world would be better that way as I would certainly {i}not{/i} be willing to share you.
lines.zh: : 我想说的就是，真希望有更多女孩像你一样。当然是出于完全自私的目的。不是我觉得这样世界会更好——因为我绝对{i}不会{/i}愿意把你分出去。

lines.en: : So if I wanted to hook up with some other guy, that’d be a total no-go?
lines.zh: : 所以如果我想跟别的男生好上，那绝对不行?

lines.en: : Right.
: How come?
lines.zh: : 为什么?

lines.en: : Come on, Sensei. You asked me to tell ya what I meant. Least ya can do is return the favor.
lines.zh: : 拜托，Sensei。是你让我说清楚我的意思的。你至少也该礼尚往来吧。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog22
: Jealousy.
lines.zh: : 嫉妒。

lines.en: : Makoto says the same thing. Something about not lettin’ other people play with your belongings and stuff?
lines.zh: : Makoto 也这么说。说什么不能让别人玩你的东西之类的?

lines.en: : Am I on the right track?
lines.zh: : 我说到点子上了?

lines.en: : I used to have feelings for someone who belonged to someone else.
lines.zh: : 我曾经对属于别人的一个人有过感情。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog23
: More than just {i}feelings,{/i} actually. But...I’ve probably always been a jealous person.
lines.zh: : 其实不只是{i}好感{/i}而已。不过……我这人大概一直都很爱嫉妒。

lines.en: : When I want someone, I want them to be {i}mine{/i} and mine alone. And I don’t want to share them because I don’t want anyone else to {i}ruin{/i} them.
lines.zh: : 我想要一个人的时候，就想让她成为{i}我的{/i}，只属于我一个人。我不想跟别人分享，因为我不想让别人{i}毁掉{/i}她。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : More than that, I think I’m worried that the person I’d be sharing would see how small I am compared to everyone else.
lines.zh: : 更重要的是，我想我担心的是，那个我要跟别人分享的人，会看出我比起其他人有多渺小。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog24
: That’s a {i}small{/i} one?! How friggin’ big do they get?!
lines.zh: : 那还叫{i}小{/i}?! 那玩意儿能有多大啊?!

lines.en: : As a person, Miku. I’m not talking about my penis.
lines.zh: : 我说的是作为一个人，Miku。我不是在说我的鸡巴。

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog25
: Do you really not feel that way? Because you’ve joked about it — but what if I really {i}did{/i} just...move on from you one day because you didn’t have something I wanted when someone else did?
lines.zh: : 你真的没这种感觉吗？你一直拿这个开玩笑——可万一有一天我{i}真的{/i}就……因为你没有我想要的东西，而别人有，就离开你了呢?

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog26
: Why...are you smiling now? That was a pretty heavy question.
lines.zh: : 为什么……你现在在笑？这问题挺沉重的啊。

lines.en: : Cause I get it when ya put it like that.
lines.zh: : 因为你这么一说，我就懂了。

lines.en: : I {i}would{/i} be sad if ya left me in the dust.
lines.zh: : 要是你把我甩在身后，我{i}会{/i}难过的。

lines.en: : I can’t give ya brains like Makoto or boobs like Futaba. I ain’t as creative as Nodoka, ain’t as stylish as Chika, and I ain’t even half as cute as Ami.
lines.zh: : 我没法给你 Makoto 那样的脑子，也没法给你 Futaba 那样的胸。我没有 Nodoka 那么有创意，没有 Chika 那么会打扮，连 Ami 一半可爱都算不上。

lines.en: : I ain’t got much, really. Don’t even have a family anymore. All I have to give is myself. So yeah...I get it now. But I don’t look at it the same way you do.
lines.zh: : 我真的没什么。连家人都没了。我能给的只有我自己。所以……嗯，我现在懂了。不过我跟你的看法不一样。

lines.en: : It’s {i}because{/i} of what I lack that I understand why you’d wanna get all that stuff elsewhere. Ain’t wrong to want more out of life...more out of a partner...and I want ya to be happy.
lines.zh: : 正{i}因为{/i}我缺这些，我才能理解你为什么想去别处找。想从生活里得到更多……从伴侣身上得到更多……这没错……而且我想让你幸福。

lines.en: : Chase after whatever it is ya want, Sensei. I ain’t goin’ anywhere.
lines.zh: : 去追你想要的东西吧，Sensei。我哪儿都不会去。

lines.en: : And I know it ain’t sayin’ much since there’re barely any guys left in Kumon-mi to begin with, but you’re the only one I need right now anyway.
lines.zh: : 我知道这话说出来没什么分量，毕竟 Kumon-mi 本来就没剩几个男的了，但你现在就是我唯一需要的那个。

lines.en: : ...What? Why’re you just lookin’ at me like that?
lines.zh: : ……什么？你干嘛这么看着我?

lines.en: : You’ve really grown up, Miku.
lines.zh: : 你真的长大了，Miku。

lines.en: : Not without help, I haven’t.
lines.zh: : 没有人帮忙，我可长不大。

lines.en: : You’ve done so much for me, Sensei. Ya helped me figure out who I am and that’s...that’s a thing I ain’t ever been able to do on my own.
lines.zh: : 你为我做了太多，Sensei。你帮我弄清了自己是谁，而那是……那是我一个人永远做不到的事。

lines.en: : There are other ways you can still help me, though...I’ve got a lot left to learn.
lines.zh: : 不过你还能用别的方式帮我……我还有很多要学的。

lines.en: : Of course. Whatever it is, just let me know.
lines.zh: : 当然。不管是什么，跟我说就行。

lines.en: : I was actually just thinking earlier about how unproblematic you’ve been so far. So if I can return the favor in any way-
lines.zh: : 我刚才其实还在想，你到现在为止一直都没给我添过麻烦。所以如果我能以任何方式报答你的话——

lines.en: : Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei。

lines.en: : ...Miku?
lines.zh: : ……Miku?

lines.en: : {i}I’ve got a lot left to learn.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我还有很多要学的。{/i}

lines.en: : Are you pickin’ up what I’m puttin’ down right now?
lines.zh: : 你听懂我的暗示了吗?

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog27
: {i}I wanna do it with you...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我想和你做……{/i}

lines.en: scene mikuparkjog28
: ...Seriously?
: {i}Seriously.{/i}
: {i}You made me really happy today...and now I wanna make you happy too.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你今天让我特别开心……所以现在我也想让你开心。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Makoto says I’m supposed to wear a condom, though.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过 Makoto 说我得戴上套。{/i}

lines.en: scene black
: {i}But I don’t wanna.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可我不想要。{/i}
